collection_policy: Explicit completed process ledgers with matching reports/captures are included, including failed readiness runs; absent or unfinished runs are not labeled accepted.
scope: Completed current-session sequential development checkpoints; not issue acceptance or randomized repeated trials.
interpretation: Process exit zero and benchmark_failed=false do not imply frame, movement-quality or visual acceptance; inspect numerical_screen failures.
Sequential single runs may differ in thermals, OS cache and binary revision; only recorded binary hashes identify executables.
Fine source profiling adds per-query timer overhead when enabled. Coarse stage instrumentation remains active when fine profiling is disabled.
Worker stage sums overlap and are not wall-clock readiness. Cold preparation, measured settled frames and capture are separate phases.
Environment lists only explicit operator overrides; inherited display/driver/session variables were not fully captured.
RGB hashes describe the reported capture encoding. Color agreement is not an independent depth/topology proof.
